% This is generated by ESQL's DedupUnsupportedTypesDocsTests. Do not edit it. See docs/reference/query-languages/esql/README.md for how to regenerate it.

`DEDUP` cannot be used when any column in scope has one of the following types: `aggregate_metric_double`, `counter_double`, `counter_integer`, `counter_long`, `date_period`, `date_range`, `exponential_histogram`, `tdigest`, or `time_duration`. Attempting to do so results in a validation error. Use `KEEP` or `DROP` before `DEDUP` to remove such columns.
